description: global_config.createEdgeConfig (POST /v1/global-config) declares a `slug` query parameter (team slug) that collides with the required body property `slug` (the config name) in the flattened request struct, so the body slug is dropped and CreateEdgeConfigRequest cannot express the config name at all (live-verified: create without body slug 400s, with body slug 201s). Remove the redundant `slug` query parameter (teamId covers team scoping) so the body property survives flattening.
